Job Posting Title:
Software Data Engineer 
 Req ID:
10160911 
 Job Description:
 About the Role & Team   

 Do you remember seeing trailer s for The Devil Wears Prada 2 earlier this summer? What about digital spots for a cruise on the Disney Wish ? Or the California Adventure Food and Wine Festival ? If you did, it was likely because of the detailed planning and execution of The Walt Disney Company’s Enterprise Media and Marketing team…and if you didn’t – it’s probably because our targeting is that good .   

   

 We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the Performance Marketing arm of this media team. We are an integrated, cross-functional team of marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and analysts who help the Media team execute highly data-driven marketing campaigns and tactics .   

   

 As a Data Engineer , you will help expand our technology portfolio of innovative campaign planning tools, complex data science workflows , and elegant web applications that blend the art of advertising with the science of data-backed insights.    

   

 This role is unique – our team is embedded directly within the Disney m edia team . We're aligned , mission-driven, and free to move fast and innovate towards our goals . You'll tackle the challenges of executing and optimizing precise paid media strateg ies , using the latest technologies and tools . If you're excited about this , please get in touch – we'd love to hear from you !   

   

 What You Will Do   

   

 C ontribute to the development of the suite of tools used by the Performance Marketing group   

 
 Drive data engineering , data modeling, and architectural standards within the team; uphold standards and rigor around pipelin e development, observability , and documentation   

 
 Create and manage end-to-end data pipelines – from source system to end consumer teams, applications, and users   

 
 Collaborate with the broader team of media/marketing experts to rapidly iterate from prototypes to high-quality, production pipelines  and applications   

 
 Implement quality controls, monitoring, and other safeguards to ensure optimizations are accurately and safely applied to in-flight ad campaigns and key business metrics are always presented accurately    

 
   

 Required Qualifications & Skills   

   

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).   

 

 3+ years of experience designing and delivering backend architectures in a production environment, with a strong understanding of design patterns and best practices.   

 
 Strong opinions on how to best use AI/LLMs in the software development process; ability to quickly discern hype from value in the quickly evolving AI landscape (and an equal ability to put it into practice)   

 
 Experience with Spark and SQL; experience building simple and maintainable data pipelines on scaled data platforms   

 
 Ability to dive deep into any technical component   

 
 Experience working in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reality-based requirements   

 
   

 Preferred Qualifications       

   

 Experience working effectively with data science teams    

 
 Specific experience with our stack: Spark, Python, Databricks/Snowflake, AWS, Terraform   

 
 Knowledge of media buying and ad platforms including DMPs, Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, Innovid , LiveRamp and DSPs (Google D isplay Video , The Trade Desk, Yahoo )    

 
   


 
The hiring range for this remote position in Burbank, CA is $106,900.00 - $143,300.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.
